# tests/

Offline pytest suite for nofluke (about 20 s): one test module per source module, plus `test_determinism.py` (same
operations give the same candidates, in separate folders and in a subprocess, and `verify` catches edits) and
`test_cli.py` (full ask/tell loops through `nofluke.cli.main`).

Folder rules: tests use `tmp_path` study folders, never the global RNG or the network; study state is built through the
public surface (`nofluke.Study`, `nofluke.cli.main`) except in the unit tests of one module.

<!-- docmap:begin (generated by tools/docmap.py; do not edit) -->
| Entry | What it is | Imported by |
|---|---|---|
| `conftest.py` | Shared test helpers: a config factory and `Sim`, an in-memory ask/tell driver over the pure planner. | `test_determinism`, `test_noise`, `test_optuna_backend`, `test_planner` (+2) |
| `scenario.py` | A fixed sequence of study operations used by the determinism and runner tests (module-level, so picklable). | `test_cli`, `test_determinism`, `test_runner` |
| `test_benchmark_problems.py` | Tests for benchmarks/problems.py and benchmarks/harness.py: known optima, noise determinism and a tiny end-to-end run. |  |
| `test_cli.py` | Tests for nofluke.cli through `main([...])`: full ask/tell loops with files, outputs, errors and exit codes. |  |
| `test_config.py` | Tests for nofluke.config: defaults, unknown keys, validation, hashes, YAML loading. |  |
| `test_determinism.py` | Determinism contract (D7): same operations give the same candidates, in separate folders and in a subprocess. |  |
| `test_journal.py` | Tests for nofluke.journal: append/read, torn lines, malformed lines, lock contention and stale locks. |  |
| `test_noise.py` | Tests for nofluke.noise against hand-computed D9 numbers, fallbacks, tie-breaks and the plausible-best set. |  |
| `test_optuna_backend.py` | Tests for nofluke.strategies.optuna_backend (`tpe`, `gp`): valid proposals, determinism, pending candidates, options. |  |
| `test_planner.py` | Tests for nofluke.planner through an in-memory `Sim`: D8 slot order, re-evaluation share, finalists, retries, seeds. |  |
| `test_rng.py` | Tests for nofluke.rng: stable, independent, index-sensitive streams. |  |
| `test_runner.py` | Tests for nofluke.runner: `optimize` with threads and processes, failures, and `run_command` with a tiny script. |  |
| `test_space.py` | Tests for nofluke.space: validation, conditionals, the unit-cube codec, plain output types. |  |
| `test_study.py` | Tests for nofluke.Study: create/open, ask/tell, duplicates and conflicts, abandon, shapes of best/status/export. |  |
<!-- docmap:end -->
